title: Nasruddin Tale 177: The Midnight Archer
summary: Waking in the dead of night, Nasruddin saw a white figure standing motionless in his garden. Suspecting a prowler, he grabbed his bow, notched an arrow, and shot the figure straigh...
full_text:
Waking in the dead of night, Nasruddin saw a white figure standing motionless in his garden. Suspecting a prowler, he grabbed his bow, notched an arrow, and shot the figure straight through the chest!

In the morning, he went out and found his own white nightshirt hanging on the clothesline, with an arrow through the middle.

Nasruddin prostrated on the lawn in prayer: "Praise be to heaven! What a miracle that I was not wearing my nightshirt when I shot it, or I would have killed myself with my own arrow!"
moral: Find gratitude in every narrow escape, even when the arrow is your own.
